visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young individuals are gathered in a brightly lit indoor living room. A person with long brown hair wearing a patterned black and gold shirt sits on the left, resting their head on their hand while looking tired. A woman with short black hair stands in the center wearing a white zip-up hoodie over a white crop top. A man in a plain grey t-shirt sits on the right, focused on his smartphone. The environment features soft warm lighting from a globe lamp and a mirror in the background. (2) The scene abruptly transitions with a high-energy montage featuring split-screen lightning effects and close-up portraits. The characters transform into fictional personas. One character has bright red hair and wears a maroon suit with glasses. Another appears as a blonde woman in a red and silver knight's armor. The third appears as a dark-haired warrior in a black hooded coat. Intense digital flame and spark overlays fill the frame during these quick transitions. (3) The setting shifts to an outdoor urban walkway under a concrete overpass. The blonde character in detailed red and silver armor walks away from the camera, looking back over her shoulder with a surprised expression. She covers her nose with a white gloved hand. The dark-haired warrior character stands nearby, holding a metallic dagger and looking resolute. The lighting is natural overcast daylight with visible greenery in the distance. (4) The red-haired character in the maroon suit stands confidently in the outdoor walkway, adjusting his glasses with his right hand. He gestures broadly with his left arm while speaking. Later, digital aura effects, specifically blue and black smoke-like energy, swirl around the dark-haired warrior character as he assumes a powerful fighting stance. The scene ends with a close-up of the male warrior's face and a final group pose.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with casual, moderate-volume conversational Mandarin speech between a female and two male voices. A light, upbeat lo-fi background track plays at a low volume. The room tone is extremely clean with no noticeable environmental noise, suggesting a high-quality studio recording. (2) A sharp, high-frequency electric 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition. Immediately, a high-tempo J-rock music track with fast drum beats and distorted electric guitars swells in volume. The vocal delivery shifts to a dramatic, narrative style with deep, emphasized articulation typical of professional voice acting. (3) Heavy percussive hits and cinematic 'boom' sound effects punctuate the transformation sequence. Synthesized digital energy sounds and energy-riser SFX overlap with the music. The speakers' voices become high-arousal and energetic, featuring shouting and dramatic pauses to match the fast visual cuts. (4) A final resonant vocal command ('起來') is delivered with significant reverb and compression, standing clearly above the driving rock music. The track concludes with a bright, digital chime stinger and a final low-frequency impact sound, marking the end of the promotional sequence.
